messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Hydroxyzine hydrochloride (HCl) and hydroxyzine pamoate are two salt forms of the same active medicine. Taken by mouth, FDA-approved labeling gives them the same approved uses, the same doses, the same warnings, and the same side effects.
The injection is the exception. It is a hydroxyzine HCl product; there is no pamoate injection, and it has its own approved uses, doses, and warnings.
The practical differences are:
- Form. Hydroxyzine hydrochloride comes as tablets and as an oral solution. Hydroxyzine pamoate comes as capsules.
- How they dissolve. Hydroxyzine hydrochloride is very soluble in water. Hydroxyzine pamoate is practically insoluble in water.
- How the strength is measured. Hydroxyzine pamoate capsules are labeled by the amount of hydroxyzine HCl they are equivalent to. A 25 mg pamoate capsule delivers the same amount of active medicine as a hydroxyzine hydrochloride 25 mg tablet.
Triples: [["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "is salt form of", "Hydroxyzine"], ["Hydroxyzine pamoate", "is salt form of", "Hydroxyzine"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "has same approved uses as", "Hydroxyzine pamoate"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "has same doses as", "Hydroxyzine pamoate"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "has same warnings as", "Hydroxyzine pamoate"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "has same side effects as", "Hydroxyzine pamoate"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride injection", "is exception", "Hydroxyzine pamoate injection"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride injection", "has own approved uses", "Hydroxyzine hydrochloride"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride injection", "has own doses", "Hydroxyzine hydrochloride"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride injection", "has own warnings", "Hydroxyzine hydrochloride"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "has form", "tablets"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "has form", "oral solution"], ["Hydroxyzine pamoate", "has form", "capsules"], ["Hydroxyzine hydrochloride", "has solubility", "very soluble in water"], ["Hydroxyzine pamoate", "has solubility", "practically insoluble in water"], ["Hydroxyzine pamoate capsules", "labeled by", "amount of hydroxyzine HCl"], ["Hydroxyzine pamoate capsule", "delivers same amount of active medicine as", "hydroxyzine hydrochloride 25 mg tablet"], ["Hydroxyzine pamoate capsule", "has strength equivalent to", "hydroxyzine hydrochloride 25 mg tablet"]]
Relations: ["delivers same amount of active medicine as", "has form", "has own approved uses", "has own doses", "has own warnings", "has same approved uses as", "has same doses as", "has same side effects as", "has same warnings as", "has solubility", "has strength equivalent to", "is exception", "is salt form of", "labeled by"]
Answer:

completion:
delivers same amount of active medicine as: The subject drug formulation provides the same quantity of active pharmaceutical ingredient as the object drug formulation.  
has form: The subject drug is available in the physical form or dosage form specified by the object entity.  
has own approved uses: The subject drug has its own specific approved medical uses that differ from those of the object entity.  
has own doses: The subject drug has its own specific dosage recommendations that differ from those of the object entity.  
has own warnings: The subject drug has its own specific safety warnings or precautions that differ from those of the object entity.  
has same approved uses as: The subject drug and object drug have identical approved medical uses.  
has same doses as: The subject drug and object drug have identical dosage recommendations.  
has same side effects as: The subject drug and object drug have identical adverse effects or side effects.  
has same warnings as: The subject drug and object drug have identical safety warnings or precautions.  
has solubility: The subject drug has the specified solubility characteristic in a solvent, typically water.  
has strength equivalent to: The subject drug formulation has a strength that is equivalent to the object drug formulation in terms of active ingredient content.  
is exception: The subject drug is an exception to the general rule or pattern described in relation to the object entity.  
is salt form of: The subject drug is a specific salt form of the active pharmaceutical ingredient specified by the object entity.  
labeled by: The subject drug formulation is labeled or measured based on the specified characteristic or quantity provided by the object entity.
